kurz: Oil carries heat evenly to every spot on a surface and carries flavour.
bild_im_kopf: Like a bridge between pan and food: without oil, only the tip of every bump touches the heat.
was_passiert: A surface is never completely smooth. Oil fills the gaps and brings the heat evenly everywhere, so the whole surface browns instead of just a few spots. How much heat an oil can take depends on whether it is refined or cold-pressed.
faustregeln: For wedges, about 1 tbsp oil per 500 g is enough.
Refined oil for high heat, cold-pressed for flavour at the end.
